method: Local Chrome replay of public world: 40 stationary ships, 105 landmasses, 30 HUD players, 450 configured flak projectiles (438 active), 10Hz snapshots, canvas 2920x1440. CPU timings; not GPU measurements or live multiplayer validation.
browserCrewCheck: Own-ship remote flak and cannon events each produced a visible flash and separate crew light targeting 61 ship meshes. Both overlap, fade to zero after 400ms, and all four lights stay enabled.
limits: Short steady-state windows on Apple M4 Pro. Mostly off-screen projectiles, stationary ships. Does not establish performance on user hardware or prove previous input lock resolved.
validation: 201 unit tests pass, production build passes; 1000-shot test verifies zero runtime light membership resyncs, light enable toggles or mesh light sorts. Concurrent flash geometry is not capped; only idle geometry is bounded.
